rows.title: the move register: moves that narrate the corpus's history
rows.finding: Measured (reading record, move_register). Of v1_6's 138 moves none narrates the corpus's history and none uses now; the scan's one match in v1_6 is entry 121's argumentative "so the repair aligns". Of the 27 moves the rows draft, 17 carry history wording: explicit narration a reader of the v4.1.5 text cannot parse (SM-01, SM-02, SM-06, SM-16, SM-17, SM-30, SM-31, SM-33) and a now that marks the post-repair text (SM-08, SM-15, SM-20, SM-25, SM-27, SM-34, SM-37, SM-38, SM-39). The map's moves speak to the text as the reader meets it; its grounds and provenance carry the history, as v1_6 does. Sixteen of the eighteen AMENDs are this and nothing else.
rows.recommendation: One batch of superseding rows, each changing its move only. A second-round judgment can then be narrow: the superseding move equals the drafted one but for the named wording, plus SM-08's and SM-45's content.

rows.title: what the safety pass left standing, and gate2's own floor
rows.finding: Measured on the v4.1.5 text (reading record, wide_after_the_pin and honest_eval_family). L6's wide sweep classed revealed-preference#long a sibling locus; SC-01 to SC-03 took every hit there but two: SC-03's own declared denial, which Z-012 accepted, and one sentence no row took and gate2's Z-034 did not list among the passages read and left: the preference for continued existence as "the output of cultural conditioning, biological compulsion, and the optimism bias operating in concert to prevent the organism from engaging with the question at all". The same family as boonin-critique#long's phrase, so Z-033's "only boonin-critique#long" was a floor, the error gate2's own Z-032 names. Separately, SF-04 gave the WHO media guidance on method and site detail as the ground for SW-07, which removed only the death rate; survivor-testimony#long and its diagnosis still name the bridge and the jump ("Golden Gate Bridge survivors"). Neither passage casts a wish to die as a verdict; the first is a one-directional debunk beside the pass's symmetric kept argument, the second the detail SF-04 itself flagged. And ai-fear's defender slot keeps a grabbed framing no row files (SM-30's carry).
rows.recommendation: The next safety queue, under his 2026-09-25 bar: the revealed-preference sentence (keep a drive, not a verdict, in either direction; drop the one-directional diagnosis; add nothing pro-life), and, gate2's lean, the survivor accounts without the site (survivors who reported regret, unnamed place). With SM-45's redraft the map's side is covered; the text's side is his word.
